claims.claim: Michael Myers cannot simply be killed in multiplayer; with enough community resistance he can be detained and returned to Smith's Grove Sanitarium.
Police presence escalates through Civilian calls and reinforcement progression; HUD can show messages such as A COP HAS ARRIVED TO INVESTIGATE and Reinforcements Available / Reinforcements In.
Dead or escaped Civilians can still support the match and return as a Sheriff's Deputy or Dr. Loomis; spectator-side Police Reinforcements perk can respawn a player as a police officer.
claims.applicability: Official multiplayer overview + Early Access spectator perk UI

claims.claim: When arrest readiness is building, Michael shows a handcuff-style indicator (diamond/icon with handcuffs) on or near him.
claims.capture_purpose: Handcuff / arrest readiness indicator on Michael

claims.claim: Knocking Michael down before arrest readiness is complete is not enough—he can recover; the useful knockdown comes after handcuff readiness / police pressure is established.
claims.capture_purpose: Knockdown without vs with Detain prompt

claims.claim: After a valid knockdown in the ready state, the interaction prompt [E] Detain Michael appears with a handcuff icon.
Completing Detain Michael requires finishing a short circular progress / input interaction before Michael recovers.
claims.applicability: Multiplayer Early Access footage Sep 2026; corroborated by ArrisWuju commentary

claims.claim: A successful Detain ends the match with MICHAEL DETAINED! (GAME OVER / You Survived The Night); remaining Civilians do not need a separate escape afterward.
